ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity (dark grey/black) pixels dominate approximately 92% of the visible surface; high-intensity (white/off-white) pixels are localized to specific focal points and scars, creating high local contrast but low global ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant dark base; high-density white annular clusters localized at the left and right distal tips; scattered linear white marks and circular rings distributed across the mid-ventral regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an approximate 45-degree angle and a sharp central vertex; depth is significant relative to the horizontal fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration with peak-to-valley amplitudes varying between 2-10 pixels along the entire continuous boundary of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward convex sweep from the peduncle junction towards the distal tips, following a parabolic curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white annular rings (likely barnacle scars) clustered heavily on the left lateral lobe and the distal right tip; smaller singular rings scattered across the central fluke.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple unaligned, high-contrast white linear pixel disruptions (scratches) present on both lobes, most notably a series of parallel tracks on the lower right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular barnacle attachment scars and miscellaneous linear rake marks across the ventral surface; distinct jagged erosion of the trailing edge topography.
other_distinctive_markers: White water turbulence/foam occluding the lower central junction of the peduncle and fluke lobes.
